text:
ana: Heads-up — noticed a p95 spike for /v1/generate after the route-weighting rollout. Dashboard aggregate p95 = 210ms but route 'realtime-fallback' shows p95 = 320ms. :thinking_face:

mike: saw that too. is it across regions or just us-east-1? :eyes:

ana: only us-east-1 so far. counts look low for that route compared to the aggregate.

priyanka: can you paste the query you used? might be a sampling/merge artifact from t-digest rollups.

ana: sure — this is the quick check I ran in the console:
```sql
SELECT pctl(95, latency_ms) as p95, count(*) as n FROM telemetry.ends WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='us-east-1' GROUP BY route
```
results: aggregate p95=210 (n=32k), route=realtime-fallback p95=320 (n=120)

kevin: low-n route will have noisy pctl, but the weird part is that the dashboard's aggregate p95 is lower than the high single-route p95. that suggests a merge-weighting issue: if the t-digests were merged without considering sample counts, percentile can go wrong.

mike: yep — we had an earlier optimization that dropped sample-count metadata for rollup to save bytes. that would break weighted merges.

ops-bot: deploy notice: telemetry-collector v2.14 deployed at 1759995000 (no errors).

sophia: UX ask — can we surface sample counts next to each pctl in the console? right now users only see p50/p95/p99 and get confused. a small badge with sample count and a tooltip explaining low-sample noise would cut down on slack threads.

priyanka: agree on both fronts: (1) fix rollup merge to be count-aware, (2) add sample-count UI and a hover note about minimum sample thresholds.

kevin: for the merge fix, proposed change: attach "n" to every t-digest shard and do weighted merge. fallback for legacy shards: assume n=shard_estimate and flag results as 'approximate'.

mike: implementation note — we still want compressed payloads. we can compress by delta-encoding counts but keep the count field. it's a small increase but avoids correctness issues.

ana: timeline? can we do hotfix for telemetry ingestion and a quick console patch? this route is on a canary rollout and product is watching.

priyanka: I'll own the telemetry change. plan: open issue + PR today, aim for canary deploy by EOD tomorrow. will also add a console ticket for sample-count UI (low-priority, target next sprint). creating issue now: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4321

mike: tagging logging/metrics owners for visibility — @kevin @sophia :+1:

kevin: I'll add a small gauge to the dashboard to show per-route sample rate and add an alert when p95 is computed from < 500 samples.

ops-bot: created incident INF-4321: Telemetry t-digest merge weighting bug (assigned to priyanka).

ana: thanks — good to have a path forward. leaving notes here for on-call: if you see a pctl jump with sample < 500, treat as potential telemetry artifact and verify raw histograms before paging. :memo:

mike: small follow-up — when you open the PR, please include a reproducible unit test that merges a heavy aggregate digest with a tiny but high-latency digest to assert weighted pctl correctness. saved us before.

priyanka: will do. will post PR link here when ready.

ana: :thumbsup:
